Virtual Camps

## Virtual Camps

## BSA Virtual Camp Opportunities

Summer camp is a highlight for Scouts of all ages each year! Boys and girls
yearn for outdoor programs that stir their imagination and interest!

Virtual camps offered by BSA councils from across the country will continue to
challenge and excite your Scout! They will be able to interact with Scouts
from across the country, all while learning new Scouting skills.

## List of Virtual Camps by Program Type

Below is a list of virtual camp opportunities hosted by local councils across
the country. We encourage you to visit their websites and find a virtual camp
(or more than one!) to take part in this summer. Whether your a Cub Scout,
Scouts BSA or Venturer, there is something for Scouts of all ages. Prices vary
depending on council and programs offered.
